messages.subject: Where to install RHadoop
parts:
I have a Hadoop cluster of 10 machines.  5 Data Node, 1 Hue Server, 1 Cloudera server, 1 Name Server, 1 Secondary Name Server, 1 RStudio Server.

The part that I'm having issues with is on what machine do I install rmr and rhdfs?

Sorry - just starting out and don't know the basics.

Thank you
Rick

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Where to install RHadoop
parts:
rhdfs, only on the machine where you use R. For rmr,  R itself, any additional packages and rmr, on the machine you are using R on and all the data nodes. We are working on a simplified installation procedure, you can track progress on issue #66. There is a proof of concept described in the comments there, but it's only for people who can work on the bleeding edge.


Antonio
